name: ELMER_ST_HIDDEN
meaning: SetState 0: anim STAND, invisible; Update: -> 1 when the Wolf is spotted (inferred)

name: ELMER_ST_APPEAR
meaning: SetState 1: scripted camera, Wolf frozen, anim APPEAR (inferred)

name: ELMER_ST_CHASE
meaning: SetState 2: anim RUN or RUN2 (rabbit costume); Update: chases, shoots (7) or hits (0xa) (inferred)

name: ELMER_ST_SHOOT_END
meaning: SetState 3: anim SHOOT3, bullet fired (msg 0x3200 series); Update: releases camera and Wolf (inferred)

name: ELMER_ST_RUN
meaning: SetState 4: anim RUN/RUN2 when changing state (inferred)

name: ELMER_ST_PATROL
meaning: SetState 5: anim SNEAK, walks the trajectory, sweeps with STAND2/SNEAK (inferred)

name: ELMER_ST_BLOCKED
meaning: SetState 6: anim STAND2; Update: -> 5 when the blocker moves away (inferred)

name: ELMER_ST_SHOOT
meaning: SetState 7: anim SHOOT1 facing the Wolf; Update: on anim end -> 3 (inferred)

name: ELMER_ST_AMBUSH
meaning: SetState 8: freezes the Wolf, 0xfa0 ms wait; Update: anim STAND3 and reach toward the Wolf (inferred)

name: ELMER_ST_HIT
meaning: SetState 0xa: anim HIT facing the Wolf (inferred)

name: ELMER_ST_HIT2
meaning: SetState 0xb: anim HIT1; Update: -> 2 on anim end (inferred)

name: ELMER_ST_CHASE_CLOSE
meaning: SetState 0xd: releases the scripted camera, anim RUN/RUN2 (inferred)

name: ELMER_ST_LOOK_AROUND
meaning: SetState 0xe: anim STAND; Update: back to patrol or shoot (inferred)

name: ELMER_ST_GO_HOME
meaning: SetState 0xf: anim STAND; Update: walks back, -> 2 on arrival (inferred)
